source.note: Tonal ramps are synthesized in OKLCH from each token (lightness 15-95%, chroma capped at 0.12); the project defines no tonal scale of its own. rule, rule-major, grid-minor, grid-major, plate and band are alpha tokens and carry their resolved-on-paper value instead of a ramp. Refreshed after the second correction round: warm near-white paper, green demoted to accent-only, .ruling per block, the .shot screenshot slot, callouts and spec lists, the hero strip, the full-bleed read-only band, the .note voice with the mono restricted to readings, and script-driven motion (rise, count-up, typing) gated by the js class and reduced motion.

plate.displayName: Plate (paper at 95%, under row copy and receipts)

rule-major.displayName: Rule Major (row dividers, callout/spec rules, dotted hairlines)

grid-major.displayName: Grid Major (paper texture, every fifth rule)

onPaper.ink-faint: 3.92:1 (never text; the shot caption's right span violates this)

onWhite.red: 5.71:1 (call-out value, stamp hover text on red reversed)

onInk.paper at 40%: link underline at rest, resolves to about #6e726e

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; Archivo wide 110%, red em clause with italics removed. 48px line at >=901px, 1.06 below. Max 19ch (16ch below 900px).

headline.purpose: Section h2s, contact h2, legal h1 (2-2.6rem). Archivo wide 110%, -0.035em. 48px line at >=901px, 1.1 below.

figure.purpose: The net-profit reading in the hero strip; condensed 68% at 6rem / 0.86, red, 10px 0 14px padding, counted up by script from data-count. Larger than any heading and the one text size not on the ruling. clamp(3.6rem,15vw,5.5rem) below 900px.

title.purpose: h3s at normal width on a 24px line with one blank rule (24px) below: var(--t-7) (rounds, steps), var(--t-8) (measures, legal h2), var(--t-6) (controls), var(--t-8) (quote).

body.purpose: var(--t-5) on a 24px line (1rem below 900px); every paragraph, list item and caption shares the 24px line. Lead var(--t-6) ink-soft; intros var(--t-6) ink-soft; row paragraphs 0.95-1rem ink-2 (callout, spec, reading-note 0.95; control 0.96; round, step, never 0.98; measure 1); legal 1rem ink-2 with a 24px paragraph margin.

note.purpose: Archivo var(--t-3) ink-soft on a 24px line for prose captions, sub-lines and footnotes: section-head meta, chart caption, rounds note, measure unit line, quote and talk notes, legal 'last updated', footer. paper-dim on the ink section. The brand tagline is var(--t-1) on a 1.2 line.

label.purpose: Condensed 78% caps at var(--t-1), ink-soft, 0.12em, on a 24px line; used above the figure. Same voice at 13px / 1.4px in the plot (.t-label green-ink, .t-unit ink-soft) and 10.5px / 1.2px in the timeline SVG.

action.purpose: Condensed 85% caps at var(--t-2), 0.08em, line-height 1, inside a 48px stamp; var(--t-2) in the 40px header stamp (var(--t-1) below 900px); var(--t-2) for nav links (0.08em) and hero facts (0.06em, on a 24px line).

band.purpose: Condensed 78% at 700, var(--t-2), 0.16em, uppercase, vertical-rl rotated 180deg. The RESOLVED stamp is the same voice at var(--t-1), 0.14em, rotated -6deg.

eyebrow.purpose: Fragment Mono var(--t-1), 0.1em, uppercase, ink-soft, on a 24px line: receipt title, callout heading, the 'Included' heading over a spec list. The shot caption is the same voice at 0.06em with its right span in ink-faint.

reading.purpose: Fragment Mono 400 on a 24px line: receipt keys/values and the gain line at var(--t-2); the sticker's first row at var(--t-2); the shot placeholder at var(--t-2) / 0.02em; plot axis text 15px in the 720-unit viewBox (about 11px effective at 1440), call-out value condensed 700 27px, call-out sub-line mono. Restricted to these uses; prose captions use .note.

Archivo.italic: separate file, declared, unused in the build

monoRestriction.rule: If an instrument could print it, it is mono; if a person wrote it, it is Archivo (.note at var(--t-3) for small prose).

shadows.name: mounted
shadows.purpose: Shot frames and the quote card at rest; a stamp on hover. Token --shadow.

shadows.name: stuck-on
shadows.purpose: The sticker: a hard 1px ink edge plus a grounded shadow. Removed on the settled round.

shadows.name: row-wash
shadows.purpose: A hovered round; resolves to about #fbfaf9 on paper.

shadows.name: paper-plate
shadows.value: background: var(--plate); padding-left: 8px; padding-right: 8px; margin-left: -8px; margin-right: -8px
shadows.purpose: .round-body, .receipt (0 side margins), .measure-body, .measure-list: paper at 95% under copy and figures so no rule sits behind a numeral.

shadows.name: hatch
shadows.value: background-color: var(--paper-deep); background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 14px, rgba(19,26,22,.045) 14px 15px)
shadows.purpose: The empty shot frame: a 1px 4.5% ink hatch every 15px over deeper paper, 'no print here yet'.

shadows.name: structural-rule
shadows.purpose: How a 1px top or bottom rule is painted without taking layout height. Ink for the top of .strip/.rounds/.measures/.never-row; rule-major under .round/.measure, above .callout/.spec, under .never-row and (mobile) .never-item; paper for the top of .controls; rgba(247,245,242,.22) under .control.

shadows.name: dotted-hairline
shadows.value: background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rule-major) 50%, transparent 50%); background-size: 4px 1px; background-repeat: repeat-x; background-position: 0 100%
shadows.purpose: Receipt dt/dd and .spec li foot rules: 2px on, 2px off, painted at the bottom edge; the last pair/item drops it.

motion.name: duration-nav
motion.purpose: Nav link colour/underline, contact email underline.

motion.name: duration-stamp
motion.purpose: Stamp background, border, colour, shadow, transform.

motion.name: duration-row
motion.purpose: Round hover wash and the triage band's scaleX extension.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: html.js [data-rise] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); transition: opacity 300ms, transform 300ms; transition-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 70ms) } .is-in { opacity: 1; transform: none }
motion.purpose: Section content enters 8px up on scroll-in via IntersectionObserver (rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0, unobserve after entry), staggered by the data-rise index 0-3; elements in view 50ms after load show at once; without IntersectionObserver or under reduced motion everything is shown at once.

motion.name: sequence-plot
motion.value: vital: stroke-dasharray/dashoffset 1200, 700ms from 150ms; .over dots: 240ms appear from 380ms in 40ms steps to 740ms; .breach at 800ms; .callout: settle 400ms at 860ms (translateY 6px to 0)
motion.purpose: The vital plots itself once on load, then the breach reports. CSS only, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; under reduced motion everything is drawn at once.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: [data-count] with data-prefix: 900ms, cubic ease-out 1-(1-p)^3, requestAnimationFrame, en-US formatting; min-width pinned to the rendered width first; threshold 0.5; runs once
motion.purpose: The -$398 figure counts up when half in view, without reflowing the strip. Skipped under reduced motion (script exits after showing everything).

motion.name: typing
motion.value: [data-typed]: min-height reserved; full copy kept in an .sr-only span; aria-hidden .typed span receives characters at clamp(9, 20, round(1500 / length)) ms each after a 250ms pause; caret via .is-typing .typed::after (2px x 0.9em ink), removed 400ms after the last character; threshold 0.6; runs once
motion.purpose: The first round's note types itself on first scroll into view, then stops. Skipped under reduced motion.

motion.name: slot-fallback
motion.value: .shot img: removed on error, or immediately if already complete with naturalWidth 0
motion.purpose: A missing screenshot leaves the mono [ SCREENSHOT: ... ] label visible. Without script the label sits under the transparent broken image.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): html.js [data-rise] visible with no transition; plot animations off and drawn; .triage::after, .stamp, .main-nav a transitions none; scroll-behavior auto
motion.purpose: The static page is the baseline. Measured CLS in the finish review: 0.

breakpoints.name: rows-tighten
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: round columns 24/170/1fr/240; measure first column 160px; measure-shot 160 / 1fr / 1.2fr.

breakpoints.name: display-line
breakpoints.purpose: min-width: the hero h1, .section-head h2, .talk h2 and .legal h1 take a 48px line; below it they fall back to 1.1.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: body 1rem; header static and two-row with scrolling nav; hero one column with display:contents reorder (h1, shot, actions, lead, facts, strip); strip 24px/1fr with 16px gap, reading one column 1u below; split stacks; rounds 24px/1fr with row-gap 0 and 24px steps (sticker margin-bottom 24, receipt margin-top 24 + padding-top 23 + 1px rule-major top rule, .done static 24px tall); measures stack body -> list/shot -> unit footnote; timeline SVG replaced by ::before nodes; never row one column with inset rules; controls and close band one column.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: 16px gutters; full-width hero stamps; facts top-aligned; sticker one column (96px tall); shot caption drops its right span and truncates; plot lettering enlarged (22/20/40/20px), call-out box x150 y0 w340 h96 with text shifted -120px, leader hidden.

texture.layer: body::before, position absolute inset 0, z-index -1, pointer-events none
texture.mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000, transparent 30%, transparent 70%, #000): full in the outer 30% of the viewport each side, absent behind the centre column

paperSections.ground: background-color var(--paper), opaque; covers the margin texture; paints no ruling of its own

rulingBlocks.rules: horizontal only: background-size 100% 120px (grid-major), 100% 24px (grid-minor), position 0 -1px, painted from the block's own top edge at every width
rulingBlocks.why: the pitch restarts where the rows start, so every row lands on a rule whatever the height of the head and intro above it

rulingGrid.plainSections: hero (.strip and the shot on the masked margin texture), #how-it-works

bandSection.ground: var(--paper-deep), full bleed, no ruling; section-head rule stays ink

inkSection.text: headings/icons/links/top rule var(--paper); running text, meta and .note var(--paper-dim); control dividers rgba(247,245,242,0.22); link underline rgba(247,245,242,0.4); selection paper on ink

baseline.bodyLine: 24px (line-height: var(--u)) on body; paragraphs, li, receipt dt/dd, .label, .eyebrow, .note, captions, sticker rows and h3 all on 24px
baseline.displayLine: 48px at >=901px for the hero h1, .section-head h2, .talk h2, .legal h1; .talk .email 48px at all widths
baseline.structuralRules: painted: box-shadow inset 0 +/-1px 0, or 4px x 1px repeating hairline; bordered rules are paid for in padding (header container 3u - 2px; .section-head/.legal-head padding-bottom 24px - 2px; .site-footer padding-top 24px - 2px; .legal h2 padding-top 24px - 1px; mobile .receipt padding-top 24px - 1px; .quote padding 2u - 1px / 1.5u / 1.5u - 1px)
baseline.rowPadding: .round 24/24; .measure 48/24; .never-item 24/24; .control 24/24; .callout 24 above + 24 under its p; .strip 24/24 with margin-top 24; h3 margin-bottom 24px
baseline.objects: .stamp 48px tall (40px in header); .sticker 72px (11px 12px padding, 1px border, two 24px lines; 96px at <=520px), margin-bottom 24 in the strip; .shot-caption 24px; .timeline-track viewBox 1152x48
baseline.legal: p and li on 24px with a 24px margin; ul margin-bottom 24; h2 24px line, margin 24 0 24, padding-top 24px - 1px

slots.files: /img/placeholder-<slot>.png per img/README.md; object-fit cover, object-position top left
slots.loading: hero eager, the rest loading=lazy; all decoding=async; width/height attributes reserve the box

rulingGrid.section: 96px (4u) vertical padding, 72px below 900px; hero 72 / 48 (48 top below 900px)

grids.strip: 24px minmax(0,6fr) minmax(0,6fr), column gap 48, grid-column 1 / -1, margin-top 24, padding 24 0, inset 0 1px 0 ink
grids.reading: auto 1fr, column gap 36, align end; .label and .chart-caption span; caption margin-top 24
grids.split: minmax(0,8fr) minmax(0,4fr), column gap 48, margin-bottom 48; .callouts padding-top 24
grids.receipt: minmax(0,1fr) auto, column gap 12, border-left 1px ink, padding-left 24
grids.measure: 200px 1.05fr 1fr, column gap 36, padding 48 0 24 (160px first column at <=1040)
grids.steps: repeat(3, 1fr), gap 36, under a 1152x48 SVG rail with 24 below
grids.never-row: repeat(4, minmax(0,1fr)); inset 0 1px 0 ink, inset 0 -1px 0 rule-major; items 22px 1fr gap 12, padding 24 24 24 0; item + item padding-left 24, border-left 1px rule-major
grids.section-head: 1fr auto, gap 24, align end, padding-bottom 24 - 2px, border-bottom 2px ink, margin-bottom 48; .section-intro margin -24 0 48

inconsistencies: The hero strip's two columns are not snapped to a shared pitch: the plot column is 72px sticker + 24px + an SVG whose height follows its width (720:236, about 169px at 1440); the reading column's figure is 6rem x 0.86 (82.56px) plus 10px 0 14px padding; the triage word sits 12px down.
--rule (12%) is declared as the structural hairline token and no selector uses it; every hairline is --rule-major.
The primary stamp's text is --paper at rest and --white on hover.
Below 900px the h1 (1.06) and h2 (1.1) line-heights are off the 24px line; the .ruling blocks restart their pitch, so the effect is contained to the heads.
Small off-grid values remain inside components: the mobile header's 12px top padding and 6px nav margin, .brand small at var(--t-1) on a 1.2 line, .shot-caption's 2px side padding.
Dead or redundant rules: .never-foot p is styled but the foot holds only a stamp; .band-section .section-head re-declares the ink rule it already has; the Archivo italic face is loaded and unused.
The direction says 1px rules; the build uses 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 3px by role.
404.html has no site footer and no font preloads; privacy.html and security.html have both.
resolvedSinceLastRecord: --red-deep and --amber removed; --amber-fill is the only amber and it is used.
.triage-ink now declares ink-soft directly (no override needed).
All display selectors share -0.035em; the h2 / legal-h1 overrides are gone.
.section-head .meta 6px pad, the plate caption's 12px margin and the hero sticker's 10px margin are gone; the strip sticker sits 24px above the plot.
Mono no longer carries prose: captions, meta, unit lines, notes and the footer are Archivo .note.
The ruled sections no longer paint a ruling behind heads and intros; .ruling is per block at every width.
The .reading block no longer carries its own rule and 10/14/8/6/4px gaps; the strip's top rule is one inset ink rule and the caption sits 24px below.
extensions.notCanonized: Generic line-icon glyphs (hero-facts shield/eye/rotate, the four .control icons) are inline SVGs the build carries; they are not recorded as a system device. The world's native marks are the ticked box, the plotted node and the triage band. The unsnapped strip and the size spray are recorded as defects, not as permitted exceptions. The mono .eyebrow is recorded as it is used (receipt title, callout heading, 'Included') and is not a licence for kickers above headings.

typeRamp.description: A closed set of type steps declared on :root. Every text size on every page is one of these; no selector carries a literal font-size outside SVG viewBox lettering. A step is a size, not a voice: family, width, weight and tracking set the voice on top of it.
typeRamp.line: Every step is set on line-height 24px; --t-head, --t-display and the contact email take 48px at >=901px. --t-figure (x0.86) is the recorded exception.

steps.roles: labels, mono eyebrows, the RESOLVED stamp, the brand tagline, the phone header stamp
mono readings (receipt, sticker, gain), shot placeholder, nav links, stamps, hero facts, triage words, phone menu links
the .note voice: captions, footnotes, meta, footer, legal dateline
row prose: rounds, measures, callouts, specs, steps, controls, never row, section note, reading note, sticker name
body and legal body; overridden on :root below 900px
row titles: round, step and control h3
section and card titles: measure h3, quote h3, legal h2
hero h1, legal h1, contact email (condensed)
the net-profit figure; overridden on :root below 900px

typeRamp.exception: SVG lettering stays in viewBox units and is outside the ramp: plot axis 15px, t-label/t-unit 13px, call-out value 27px, timeline 10.5px; below 520px the plot enlarges to 22/20/40px. A value that must scale with its drawing cannot take a fixed step.
typeRamp.rule: A new element reuses a step. Adding a size is a design-system change made once on :root and named, never a local font-size.

verified.detector: 0 findings across styles.css, index.html, privacy.html, security.html, 404.html

typeRamp.exceptionDetail: The plot's lettering is authored in viewBox units (15 / 13 / 27px) and scales with the SVG: about 11 / 9.4 / 19px effective at 1440, hence the enlarged sizes below 520px.

components.css: .ds-stamp{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:"Archivo","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;font-stretch:85%;font-weight:600;font-size:.86rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:var(--paper, #f7f5f2);background:var(--ink, #131a16);border:1.5px solid var(--ink, #131a16);border-radius:2px;height:48px;padding:0 22px;line-height:1;transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-stamp:hover{background:var(--red, #c0301c);border-color:var(--red, #c0301c);color:var(--white, #ffffff);box-shadow:0 10px 28px -12px rgba(19,26,22,.28), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(19,26,22,.14)}.ds-stamp:active{transform:translateY(1px);box-shadow:none}.ds-stamp:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red, #c0301c);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-receipt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;column-gap:12px;align-items:end;font-family:"Fragment Mono","Courier New",monospace;font-size:.8rem;line-height:24px;background:var(--plate, rgba(247,245,242,.95));border-left:1px solid var(--ink, #131a16);padding:0 8px 0 24px;max-width:290px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-receipt dt,.ds-receipt dd{margin:0;padding:0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rule-major, rgba(19,26,22,.22)) 50%,transparent 50%);background-size:4px 1px;background-repeat:repeat-x;background-position:0 100%}.ds-receipt dt{color:var(--ink-soft, #4a5951)}.ds-receipt dd{color:var(--ink, #131a16);text-align:right;white-space:nowrap}.ds-receipt dt:nth-last-of-type(1),.ds-receipt dd:last-child{background-image:none}.ds-receipt .ds-neg{color:var(--red, #c0301c)}.ds-receipt .ds-pos{color:var(--green-ink, #256a42)}.ds-receipt .ds-eyebrow{display:block;grid-column:1/-1;font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-soft, #4a5951);line-height:24px}

narrative.overview:
The site is the observation chart clipped to the end of the bed on a 6am ward round. The ground is warm near-white stock (`paper`) ruled every 24px with a heavier line every fifth; the ruling is a paper texture that is strongest in the outer margins and fades out behind the centre column, and inside the form blocks it is repainted horizontally from each block's own top edge, so every row starts on a rule regardless of what precedes it. Everything on the chart is either ink (near-black green), a white paper object stuck onto it (sticker, quote card, plot call-out), a bordered screenshot slot where the product itself is mounted, or a coloured triage band down the margin. Nothing floats and nothing is a card: the plot in the first viewport is drawn straight onto the ground, the brief is a list of triage rows separated by 1px rules, and the seven feature measures are observation rows, two of them carrying a screenshot. One full-bleed band (`#read-only`) rests on the deeper paper, and one section, Security, is printed in reverse: ink ground, paper type, the same 24px ruling at 5% paper. The theme is light only and permanently so (`color-scheme: light`); there is no dark mode.

Density is that of a printed form: body text sits on the 24px ruling (17px on a 24px line), section h2s take a 48px line, structural rules are painted rather than laid out so they never push the pitch off, and sections are separated by a 2px ink rule with a small right-aligned note ("Today's rounds · 4 items · sample") rather than by whitespace or colour blocks. The world is read in three type voices from one variable family plus a mono: Archivo set wide (110%) for the two display levels, Archivo set condensed (78–85%) in tracked caps for form labels, stamps and triage bands, and Fragment Mono for readings only: receipts, ASINs, the plot's lettering, the gain line, the screenshot slot's caption and label, and short eyebrows. Prose captions and footnotes are not readings and are set in Archivo at var(--t-3) (`.note`). The largest thing on the page is a number, not a headline: the net-profit figure is set at 6rem in condensed 700 while the h1 tops out at 2.7rem.

Colour is diagnostic, never decorative. Red is the one accent: the breach reading, the h1's thesis clause, and the hover state of every action. Green is accent-only: the SCALE band and the target band's edge (`green`), positive figures (`green-ink`), the translucent target wash (`band`). Amber is the REORDER band. There is no glass, no glow, no colour gradient, no drop-shadow on the ground itself. Motion is restraint-level and entirely an enhancement: with script off or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the page is complete and static. With script, section content rises 8px on scroll-in, the vital plots itself once, the net-profit figure counts up once, and one note in the brief types itself once. Measured cumulative layout shift in the finish review: 0.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-white stock (`paper`) ruled at 24px, heavier every 120px; the ruling is the layout unit and the baseline: text sits on 24px lines, h2s on 48px.

The ruling is texture, not structure: a masked two-axis grid in the page margins (`body::before`) and a horizontal-only `.ruling` painted from the top of each form block (the rounds list, every measure row); separate `rule` tokens for the hairlines that actually divide things.
Three type voices from two families: Archivo wide (display), Archivo condensed caps (labels, stamps, bands), Fragment Mono (readings only); prose captions in the Archivo `.note` voice.
Red / amber / green / settled-grey triage bands as 24px vertical margin strips with rotated condensed caps.
Four screenshot slots (`.shot`): a mono caption bar over a bordered, hatched `paper-deep` frame that reserves its aspect ratio and shows a mono `[ SCREENSHOT: … ]` label until the file exists.

White paper objects (stickers, quote card, plot call-out) and the shot frames are the only things that cast a shadow; near-opaque paper plates sit under row copy and receipts so no rule crosses a numeral.
2px radius on stamped, stuck-on and mounted objects, 0 everywhere else; 1px rules for structure, 2px for the form's header and section rules, all painted so they take no layout height.
One deeper-paper band and one ink section in the run of paper; the settled state recedes by ink colour, never by opacity.
Every authored motion runs once, is gated by the `js` class and by reduced motion, and never moves layout.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red is the only colour that may appear as an accent on paper. Green is a triage class and a positive figure; amber is a triage class; neither colours a heading, a link, a button or a decorative element.

rules.name: The Green Split Rule
rules.body: `green` fills and strokes; `green-ink` writes. A green value in text is always `green-ink` (6.00:1); a green area or line is always `green`.

rules.name: The Red Is A Reading Rule
rules.body: Red marks a value that is out of range or the action the reader is about to take. It never colours a heading, a border for emphasis, or a decorative element; the h1's red clause is the one exception and it is the page's thesis.

rules.name: The Faint Is Not Text Rule
rules.body: `ink-faint` sits at 3.92:1 and is used only for strikes, hover underlines, markers and the scrollbar. Text at any size uses `ink-soft` or darker.

rules.name: The Texture Is Not Structure Rule
rules.body: The ruling is drawn with `grid-minor` / `grid-major` (4.5% / 10%) and never with `rule` / `rule-major` (12% / 22%). A line that separates two things is a rule token at full width; a line that is merely paper is a grid token and may be masked away or covered by a plate.

rules.name: The One Ink Section Rule
rules.body: Security is the page's only reversed section: `ink` ground, `paper` headings, icons, links and top rule, `paper-dim` running text and notes, 5% paper ruling, dividers in paper (top) and 22% paper (between controls), selection inverted to paper-on-ink. The `#read-only` band is a rest on deeper paper, not a second dark section.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Wide for the two display levels, condensed caps for anything that labels or stamps, mono for anything that is a reading. A new element picks one voice; it does not mix wide with caps or set a reading in the sans.

rules.name: The Mono Is A Reading Rule
rules.body: Fragment Mono is restricted to `.receipt`, the sticker's identifier and marketplace, the plot's lettering, the figure's gain line, `.shot-caption`, `.shot-placeholder` and `.eyebrow`. A caption, footnote, dateline or sub-line that is prose is set in the Archivo `.note` voice, never in the mono. The test: if it could be printed by the instrument, it is mono; if a person wrote it, it is not.

rules.name: The Figure Outranks The Headline Rule
rules.body: The number that matters is set larger than any heading on the page (6rem against a 2.7rem h1). A new surface that leads with a reading keeps that order.

rules.name: The Line Is 24px Rule
rules.body: Text is set on `line-height: var(--u)` regardless of size: 17px body, 15–16px row copy, 13.6px notes, 12.8px mono and 12px labels all occupy one 24px rule; h2s and the contact email occupy two. A new size picks a line of 24px or 48px, not a ratio. The figure (6rem × 0.86) is the recorded exception; the h1 at 1.06 is a recorded defect, not an exception.

rules.name: The Ruling Rule
rules.body: Vertical structure lands on 24px or a named sub-unit, and text lands on the 24px line. A rule that separates rows is painted (inset shadow or repeating hairline) and takes no height; a rule that is a real border is paid for by shrinking the box it sits on (`Nu − 2px`, `Nu − 1px`).

rules.name: The Ruling Restarts Rule
rules.body: The horizontal ruling belongs to the form block, not the section: `.ruling` goes on the list or row whose lines must land on rules (`.rounds`, each `.measure`), and it paints from that block's own top. A section never paints a ruling behind a heading, an intro or a screenshot.

rules.name: The Ground Rule
rules.body: A section is one of four grounds: plain (the masked margin texture shows through; for the hero and the timeline), paper (`.ruled`: opaque `paper`, for sections whose content is rows of text or the quote), band (`.band-section`: full-bleed `paper-deep`, one per page, for the read-only rest), or ink (`#security` only). A new text-heavy section takes `.ruled` and puts `.ruling` on its rows; a new visual section stays plain.

rules.name: The Plate Rule
rules.body: Where copy or figures sit inside a `.ruling` block, they sit on a paper plate (`plate`, 8px side padding, −8px side margins) so the ruling is a texture between blocks and never a line through a word or a number.

rules.name: The Slot Rule
rules.body: A product image never appears bare or in an ad-hoc frame. It goes in a `.shot` with a fixed aspect class, a mono caption bar above, `width`/`height` on the ``, and the mono `[ SCREENSHOT: slot · ratio ]` label beneath, so the page reads the same with or without the file and never shifts when it arrives.

rules.name: The Paper Object Rule
rules.body: Only `white` objects with a 1px ink border (sticker, quote card, call-out) and the mounted shot frames cast a shadow. Nothing else on the ground does, and nothing gets a shadow to signal importance.

rules.name: The Ink Recedes Rule
rules.body: A settled item recedes by colour only: heading, copy and sticker to `ink-soft`, band to `ink-soft`, sticker shadow removed, receipt values to `ink-2`, heading struck through in `ink-faint`. Opacity is never used to age content, so the settled row stays above the contrast floor.

rules.name: The Enhancement Rule
rules.body: Motion is added by the `js` class and removed by `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`; the static page is the baseline, not a fallback. A new motion hooks onto `html.js` or the `no-preference` query and reserves its space (`min-width`, `min-height`, `aspect-ratio`) before it runs.

rules.name: The Once Rule
rules.body: Every authored motion runs exactly once, on entry, and then unobserves: the rise, the plot, the count-up, the typing. Nothing loops, nothing replays on scroll-back, nothing responds to the pointer beyond a 160–200ms colour or transform transition.

dos: **Do** size structure on the ruling: 24px and its multiples (1u, 1.5u, 2u, 3u, 4u) for padding, heights and section rhythm; 2–22px only inside a component; and when a box carries a real border, shrink its padding by the border (`24px − 2px`, `24px − 1px`) so the next line still lands on a rule.
**Do** set every text size on `line-height: var(--u)` (24px) and h2s on 48px at ≥901px; pick a line of 24 or 48, never a ratio.
**Do** paint 1px structural rules instead of laying them out: `box-shadow: inset 0 ±1px 0` for row, list, callout and spec edges, a 4px × 1px repeating gradient for dotted hairlines.

**Do** give a text-heavy section `.ruled` (opaque paper) and put `.ruling` on the block whose rows must land on rules, with its copy and figures on paper plates (`plate`, 8px / −8px sides); leave the hero and diagrams on the plain masked ground.
**Do** draw data straight onto the ground. A plot, a list of rows, a timeline gets a top rule and dividers, not a card.
**Do** mount every product image in a `.shot`: fixed aspect class, mono caption bar, `width`/`height` on the ``, mono `[ SCREENSHOT: slot · ratio ]` label beneath, filename from `img/README.md`.
**Do** pick one type voice per element: wide 110% for h1/h2, condensed 78–85% caps for labels, stamps and bands, Fragment Mono for readings and eyebrows, and normal width for h3s, body and notes.
**Do** set prose captions, footnotes, datelines and sub-lines in the Archivo `.note` voice (var(--t-3), `ink-soft`, 24px line); keep the mono for what an instrument would print.
**Do** set the leading number larger than the heading when a surface leads with a reading (6rem figure over a 2.7rem h1).
**Do** use `green-ink` for any green text and `green` only for fills and strokes; use `ink-soft` (6.80:1) as the floor for text on paper and `paper-dim` (10.20:1) as the floor for text on ink.

**Do** give stuck-on white objects a 1px ink border, 2px radius and a grounded shadow (`--shadow` or the sticker's 1px hard edge), give the shot frame the same border, radius and shadow over hatched `paper-deep`, and give nothing else a shadow.
**Do** age content by moving it to `ink-soft` and removing its shadow; keep its band, sticker and receipt in place.
**Do** keep the 24px triage band as a vertical strip with the word rotated to read upward, ink text on amber, white on red and green.

**Do** gate every authored motion behind `html.js` or `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, run it once on entry, and reserve its space before it starts (pin `min-width` before a count-up, `min-height` before typing).
**Do** extend or reveal on hover with `transform` on a pseudo-element (the band's `scaleX`) and a 160–200ms `--ease-out` transition.
**Do** label sample data in the `.note` voice directly beneath it ("Illustrative sample data, not a real account.").

**Do** reorder the phone hero so the product is second (h1, shot, actions, lead, facts, strip), stack measure rows body → list or shot → unit line, and enlarge SVG lettering below 520px rather than letting the plot's text scale down with it.
donts: **Don't** add a radius above 2px, a pill, or a rounded card; the only circles are plotted nodes.
**Don't** add a dark mode or a second theme; the page is `color-scheme: light` and the one ink section is a change of stock, not a theme.
**Don't** use opacity to fade, age or de-emphasise content; move it to a lighter ink token.
**Don't** use `ink-faint` for text at any size, or `green` for text.
**Don't** put red on a heading, border or background for emphasis, or green and amber anywhere but a triage band, a positive figure and the plot's target band.
**Don't** introduce glass, blur, glow, a colour gradient, or a shadow under anything that is not a white paper object or a shot frame.
**Don't** set a prose caption, footnote, meta line or unit line in Fragment Mono; the mono is for receipts, identifiers, plot lettering, the gain line, the slot's caption and label, and eyebrows.
**Don't** wrap the plot, a receipt or a row list in a container, panel or tinted block; a paper plate hides the ruling and is not a panel.
**Don't** paint a ruling on a section; put `.ruling` on the block (a list, a row) so the pitch restarts where the rows start.
**Don't** draw the ruling with `rule` / `rule-major`, or a divider with `grid-minor` / `grid-major`; texture and structure are different tokens.
**Don't** let the two-axis texture run behind the reading column, or let a rule cross a word or a numeral; mask it, rule horizontally, or plate over it.
**Don't** place a product image outside a `.shot`, or leave a slot without `width`/`height` and an aspect class.
**Don't** add a second ink section or a second full-bleed band; Security is the one reversed page of the form and read-only is its one rest.
**Don't** animate width, height or layout; the band extends with `scaleX`, the plot draws with `stroke-dashoffset`, the rise is an 8px transform, and the counted figure is pinned to its final width.
**Don't** replay a motion, loop it, or run it without the `js` gate and the reduced-motion gate.
**Don't** set h3s or body copy wide; the width axis above 100% is the display's alone.
**Don't** invent another label, mono or prose size; reuse the nearest existing pairing from the size note under Typography.
